$comment: Brand content for the catalog: the story Fourthwall doesn't hold (ID, collection, category, Scripture, copy). Fourthwall supplies variants, prices, stock and photos; a product shows on the site only when its slug (or fourthwallSlug) matches a Fourthwall product. `colors` maps garment color names to brand swatch tokens. `images` are fallback art (apps/web/public/products) for products without Fourthwall photos.

collections.name: Royal Heritage
collections.story: The throne of grace and a kingdom that cannot be shaken, carved in arches and ornament.

collections.name: Broken Bond
collections.story: Chains broken and death without dominion. Stand firm in what was won.

collections.name: Rolled Away
collections.story: The stone rolled away and the tomb empty at dawn. New life, worn plainly.

story.art: The tomb stands open at dawn, the stone rolled back and light spilling from the doorway beneath the wordmark.
story.front: Small Thorn Cross, left chest, bone ink
story.back: Thornbound wordmark over the open tomb, rolled stone and rising sun
story.paraphrase: At dawn the women found the stone moved and the tomb empty. He had risen.
story.fit: Oversized tee · dropped shoulder, boxy body

story.paraphrase: Christ was raised and will never die again. Death has no hold on him.
